title: Switch PipeWire audio profile
summary: Change the active profile of an audio device (e.g., from Analog Stereo to HDMI) using wpctl.

steps.explain: List available devices and their IDs using wpctl status.
Set the profile for the desired device ID. Profile 1 is usually Analog Stereo, 3 is often HDMI or Digital Stereo.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the audio device from wpctl status

placeholders.name: PROFILE_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the profile to switch to (e.g., 1 for Analog, 3 for HDMI)
